ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/tan) regions localized at distal tips and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity black field; high-intensity white/grey pigment clusters are localized at the distal tip of the left lobe; distinct brown/tan textured clusters (barnacles) are mapped to the extreme lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge; peaks and valleys range from 2 to 12 pixels in amplitude; highest frequency of serration observed on the right lobe trailing edge against the water background.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear disruptions; prominent vertical parallel rake marks on the right lobe; sparse diagonal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; extensive white linear scarring (likely rake marks) on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
